```{r function to compute pathway deviation}
compute_pathway_deviation <- function(mat, agg_col) {

  # r_p^aggr : aggregated pathway ratios
  r_aggr <- mat[, agg_col]

  # r_{p,i} : individual pathway ratios
  indiv_mat <- mat[, setdiff(colnames(mat), agg_col), drop = FALSE]

  # number of individual signatures (n)
  n <- ncol(indiv_mat)

  tibble(
    pathway = rownames(mat),

    # med(r_p) across ALL individual signatures (zeros included)
    median_individual = apply(
      indiv_mat,
      1,
      function(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),

    # r_p^aggr
    aggregated = r_aggr,

    # D_p = (1 / n) * (r_p^aggr - med(r_p))^2
    deviation_score = (1 / n) * (r_aggr - median_individual)^2
  )
}
```

```{r combine upregulated results from microarray and RNAseq}

up_micro_indiv <- as.matrix(up_pathway_df[, microarray_cols, drop = FALSE])

storage.mode(up_micro_indiv) <- "numeric"

# proportion non-zero
```

```{r}
sq_dev_df <- bind_rows(
  sq_dev_up,
  sq_dev_dn
) %>%
  # Remove pathways where both underlying values are zero
  filter(
    !is.na(aggregated),
    !is.na(median_individual),
    !(aggregated == 0 & median_individual == 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = factor(
      direction,
      levels = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated")
    )
  )

pdf(
  here("figures/figure3/Figure3_squared_deviation_dominant_pathways_80pct.pdf"),
  width = 6,
  height = 8
)

ggplot(
  sq_dev_df,
  aes(
    x = enrichment,
    y = deviation_score,
    fill = enrichment
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = 10^seq(-10, 0, by = 2),
    labels = seq(-10, 0, by = 2)
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    direction ~ technology,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Enrichment",
    y = expression(log[10] * " squared deviation")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA)
  )

dev.off()
```

```{r}
mw_table <- sq_dev_df %>%
  # exclude pathways with no signal in either measurement
  filter(
    !is.na(aggregated),
    !is.na(median_individual),
    !(aggregated == 0 & median_individual == 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(direction, technology) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    
    non_dominant <- .x$deviation_score[
      .x$enrichment == "Non-dominant\nGO:BP terms"
    ]
    
    dominant <- .x$deviation_score[
      .x$enrichment == "Dominant\nGO:BP terms"
    ]
    
    # remove missing deviation scores
    non_dominant <- non_dominant[!is.na(non_dominant)]
    dominant <- dominant[!is.na(dominant)]
    
    test <- wilcox.test(
      x = non_dominant,
      y = dominant,
      alternative = "greater",  # H1: non-dominant > dominant
      exact = FALSE
    )
    
    tibble(
      group1 = "Non-dominant",
      group2 = "Dominant",
      n1 = length(non_dominant),
      n2 = length(dominant),
      statistic = unname(test$statistic),
      p = test$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
    significant = p.adj < 0.05
  )

mw_table
```


```{r}
mw_table$technology <- factor(
  mw_table$technology,
  levels = c("Microarray", "RNAseq")
)


mw_gt_table <- mw_table %>%
  arrange(technology) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = paste0(group1, " vs ", group2),
    p = signif(p, 3),
    p.adj = signif(p.adj, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Direction = direction,
    Technology = technology,
    `Dominant pathways (≥90% enriched)` = n1,
    `Non-dominant pathways (<90% enriched)` = n2,
    Statistic = statistic,
    `p-value` = p,
    `Adjusted p-value` = p.adj,
    #Significance = p.adj.signif
  ) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Technology") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Dominant pathways exhibit statistically lower deviation across technologies",
    subtitle = "Mann-Whitney tests comparing ≥90% vs. <90% enriched pathways"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    everything()
  ) %>%
  fmt_scientific(
    columns = c(Statistic,`p-value`, `Adjusted p-value`),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    everything() ~ px(150)
  )
# Save the table as HTML
gtsave(mw_gt_table, here("figures/figure3/tableS5_stats_dominant_pathways.html"))
```

```{r all-thresholds-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

thresholds <- c(0.95,0.90,0.85,0.80,0.75,0.70,0.60)
summary_df <- read_tsv(
  here("figures/figure2/metadata_annotation/annotation_table.tsv"),show_col_types = FALSE)

up_pathway_df <- read_tsv(here("figures/figureS4/figureS4a/marray_rnaseq_asinh_up_pathways_sensitivity.tsv"),show_col_types = FALSE)
dn_pathway_df <- read_tsv(here("figures/figureS4/figureS4b/marray_rnaseq_asinh_dn_pathways_sensitivity.tsv"),show_col_types = FALSE)

get_available_thresholds <- function(
    pathway_df,
    direction_name
) {
  
  tibble(
    aggregate_col = colnames(pathway_df)
  ) %>%
    filter(
      str_detect(
        aggregate_col,
        "^aggregated_(microarray|RNAseq)_0-[0-9]+$"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      technology = case_when(
        str_detect(
          aggregate_col,
          "^aggregated_microarray_"
        ) ~ "Microarray",
        
        str_detect(
          aggregate_col,
          "^aggregated_RNAseq_"
        ) ~ "RNAseq"
      ),
      
      # Convert 0-95 to 0.95, 0-9 to 0.90, etc.
      threshold_value = aggregate_col %>%
        str_extract("0-[0-9]+$") %>%
        str_replace("-", ".") %>%
        as.numeric() %>%
        round(2),
      
      direction = direction_name
    )
}

available_thresholds <- bind_rows(
  get_available_thresholds(
    up_pathway_df,
    "Upregulated"
  ),
  get_available_thresholds(
    dn_pathway_df,
    "Downregulated"
  )
) %>%
  filter(
    threshold_value %in% thresholds
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    direction,
    technology,
    match(threshold_value, thresholds)
  )

# Show the aggregate columns that will be used
print(available_thresholds)

expected_combinations <- crossing(
  direction = c(
    "Upregulated",
    "Downregulated"
  ),
  technology = c(
    "Microarray",
    "RNAseq"
  ),
  threshold_value = thresholds
)

missing_combinations <- expected_combinations %>%
  anti_join(
    available_thresholds %>%
      select(
        direction,
        technology,
        threshold_value
      ),
    by = c(
      "direction",
      "technology",
      "threshold_value"
    )
  )


calculate_threshold_deviation <- function(
    pathway_df,
    direction_name,
    technology_name,
    threshold,
    aggregate_col
) {
  
  technology_key <- if_else(
    technology_name == "Microarray",
    "microarray",
    "RNAseq"
  )
  
  aggregate_signature_id <- if_else(
    technology_name == "Microarray",
    "aggregated_microarray",
    "aggregated_RNAseq"
  )
  
  individual_cols <- intersect(
    colnames(pathway_df),
    summary_df$signature_name[
      summary_df$technology == technology_key &
        summary_df$signature_ID != aggregate_signature_id
    ]
  )
  
  if (length(individual_cols) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No individual signatures found for ",
      technology_name
    )
  }
  
  if (!aggregate_col %in% colnames(pathway_df)) {
    stop(
      "Aggregate column not found: ",
      aggregate_col
    )
  }
  
  individual_mat <- as.matrix(
    pathway_df[, individual_cols, drop = FALSE]
  )
  
  storage.mode(individual_mat) <- "numeric"
  
  aggregated <- as.numeric(
    pathway_df[[aggregate_col]]
  )
  
  median_individual <- apply(
    individual_mat,
    1,
    function(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  proportion_enriched <- rowMeans(
    individual_mat != 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  n_signatures <- ncol(individual_mat)
  
  tibble(
    pathway = pathway_df$Description,
    median_individual = median_individual,
    aggregated = aggregated,
    proportion_enriched = proportion_enriched,
    deviation_score =
      (aggregated - median_individual)^2 /
      n_signatures,
    technology = technology_name,
    direction = direction_name,
    threshold_value = threshold,
    aggregate_col = aggregate_col,
    enrichment = if_else(
      proportion_enriched >= threshold,
      "Dominant\nGO:BP terms",
      "Non-dominant\nGO:BP terms"
    )
  )
}

sq_dev_all_thresholds <- available_thresholds %>%
  pmap_dfr(
    function(
        aggregate_col,
        technology,
        threshold_value,
        direction
    ) {
      
      pathway_df <- if (
        direction == "Upregulated"
      ) {
        up_pathway_df
      } else {
        dn_pathway_df
      }
      
      calculate_threshold_deviation(
        pathway_df = pathway_df,
        direction_name = direction,
        technology_name = technology,
        threshold = threshold_value,
        aggregate_col = aggregate_col
      )
    }
  ) %>%
  
  filter(
    !is.na(aggregated),
    !is.na(median_individual),
    !(
      aggregated == 0 &
        median_individual == 0
    )
  )

threshold_levels <- paste0(
  thresholds * 100,
  "%"
)

sq_dev_all_thresholds <- sq_dev_all_thresholds %>%
  mutate(
    threshold = paste0(
      threshold_value * 100,
      "%"
    ),
    threshold = factor(
      threshold,
      levels = threshold_levels
    ),
    direction = factor(
      direction,
      levels = c(
        "Upregulated",
        "Downregulated"
      )
    ),
    technology = factor(
      technology,
      levels = c(
        "Microarray",
        "RNAseq"
      )
    ),
    enrichment = factor(
      enrichment,
      levels = c(
        "Dominant\nGO:BP terms",
        "Non-dominant\nGO:BP terms"
      )
    )
  )

plot_counts <- sq_dev_all_thresholds %>%
  count(
    direction,
    technology,
    threshold,
    enrichment,
    name = "n"
  )

print(plot_counts)
```
